title: Apple Continues To Post Steep Loss In Late-Day Trading
text: Apple Continues To Post Steep Loss In Late-Day Trading CUPERTINO (dpa-AFX) - Shares of Apple Inc. (AAPL) continue to see significant weakness in late-day trading on Friday after gapping open sharply lower. Apple is currently down by 7.4 percent, on pace to end the session at its in three months.The initial sell-off by Apple after the tech giant reported fiscal fourth quarter earnings and revenues that exceeded estimates but weaker than expected iPhone shipments.Apple also forecast fiscal first quarter revenues of $89 to $93 billion, with the midpoint below the consensus estimate of $93 billion.Copyright RTT News/dpa-AFX
